import sys, json
sys.path.insert(0,'/workspace/submission'); sys.path.insert(0,'/workspace/tmp')
import fab, exact

def build(fabric, profile, guard, trace):
    F = fab.Fab(fabric, None, build=False)
    m = exact.calib_model(profile)
    return F.replay(guard, trace, m)

PS = 10**6

def base_fabric(**kw):
    f = {"n":2,"interval_ns":10,"slice_ns":40,"offset_ns":0,
         "drift_ppb":[0,0],"heat":[],
         "anchors":[[0,0,4]],
         "links":[{"ends":[[0,0,0],[1,0,1]],"delay_ns":[5,5],"defer_rounds":[0,0]}],
         "slices":[[0]],"blackouts":[],"guards_ns":[0,5,15],"reconfig_ns":0}
    f.update(kw)
    return f

prof0 = {"groups":2,"jitter_ps":[0,0],"measurements":[[0,1,0,0]]}

def tr(**kw):
    t = {"rounds":4,"rates_ppb":[[0,0] for _ in range(4)],"bias_ps":[0,0],
         "sends":[],"lost":[],"reboots":[],"queries":[]}
    t.update(kw)
    return t

fails = []
def chk(name, cond, info=''):
    if not cond:
        fails.append((name, info))
        print('FAIL', name, info)
    else:
        print('ok', name)

# T1 guard window equality
f = base_fabric()
sends = [[i, i, 0, 0] for i in range(4)]  # codes link0 dir0 at ticks 0..3; rho=0,10,20,30
out = build(f, prof0, 15, tr(sends=sends, queries=[1]))
chk('T1 guard statuses', out['send_status'] == ['guard','sent','sent','guard'], out['send_status'])

# T2 blackout boundaries: blackout [1,2) on link0
f = base_fabric(blackouts=[[0,1,2]])
sends = [[0,0,0,0],[1,1,0,0],[2,0,0,0]]  # t0 d=5 m=1 ok; t1 phase1 blackout; t2 phase2 ok
# t=0: window [0,0]; rho 0 ; guard 0: 0+5<=40 ✓ sent (arrival 5ns < next boundary)

chk('T2 blackout statuses', out['send_status'] == ['sent','blackout','sent'], out['send_status'])
# d=15 (m=2) from phase 0 covers intervals [0,1] -> blackout
f = base_fabric(blackouts=[[0,1,2]],
                links=[{"ends":[[0,0,0],[1,0,1]],"delay_ns":[15,15],"defer_rounds":[0,0]}])
out = build(f, prof0, 0, tr(sends=[[0,0,0,0]]))

# exact-boundary arrival: d=10 (m=1) from phase0 arrives at boundary phase1: window [0,0] only
f = base_fabric(blackouts=[[0,1,2]],
                links=[{"ends":[[0,0,0],[1,0,1]],"delay_ns":[10,10],"defer_rounds":[0,0]}])
out = build(f, prof0, 0, tr(sends=[[0,0,0,0]]))
chk('T2c arrival on boundary clear', out['send_status'] == ['sent'], out['send_status'])

# T3 competing sends, tie -> smallest id adopted
f = base_fabric(links=[{"ends":[[0,0,0],[1,0,1]],"delay_ns":[10,10],"defer_rounds":[0,0]},
                       {"ends":[[0,1,0],[1,1,1]],"delay_ns":[10,10],"defer_rounds":[0,0]}],
                slices=[[0,1]])
out = build(f, prof0, 0, tr(sends=[[7,0,0,0],[5,0,2,0]], queries=[1]))

chk('T3 tie adopted id', st['adopted'][1] == 5 and out['adopted'] == 1, st)
chk('T3 delivered', out['delivered'] == 2 and out['send_status'] == ['sent','sent'], out)

# T4 stale by source reboot; anchor after reboot does not help

                anchors=[[0,0,4],[0,1,2]])
out = build(f, prof0, 0, tr(sends=[[1,1,0,0]], reboots=[[2,0]], queries=[2,3]))
chk('T4 stale', out['stale_payloads'] == 1 and out['delivered'] == 1 and out['adopted'] == 0, out)
# state at 2: node0 anchored (phase 2? anchors [[0,0,4]] covers all) err 0 gen 1
chk('T4 gen', out['states'][0]['generations'][0] == 1, out['states'][0])

# T5 unknown payload from unknown sender, sender anchored later
f = base_fabric(anchors=[[0,0,4],[1,2,4]],
                links=[{"ends":[[1,0,1],[0,1,0]],"delay_ns":[10,10],"defer_rounds":[0,0]}])

# T7 peak pre-reboot value; T8 same-boundary reboot then anchor

# anchor at phase 1 re-zeroes after reboot (anchor [0,0,4] covers phase 1!) -> known 0
chk('T8 anchor after reboot', out['states'][0]['bounds_as'][0] == 0 and out['states'][0]['generations'][0] == 1, out['states'][0])

# always_known
out = build(f, prof0, 0, tr(rates_ppb=rates))
chk('always_known false w/ node1 unanchored', out['always_known'] == False, out)
f2 = base_fabric(anchors=[[0,0,4],[1,0,4]], drift_ppb=[0,0])
out = build(f2, prof0, 0, tr(rates_ppb=[[0,0]]*4, queries=[0]))
chk('always_known true', out['always_known'] == True and out['peak_known_abs_as'] == 0, out)

# T9 half-picosecond correction + jitter sign
prof = {"groups":2,"jitter_ps":[1,1],"measurements":[[0,1,2,5]]}
f = base_fabric(links=[{"ends":[[0,0,0],[1,0,1]],"delay_ns":[10,10],"defer_rounds":[0,0]}],

trace = tr(sends=[[0,0,0,-2*PS]], bias_ps=[0,4], queries=[1])
out = build(f, prof, 0, trace)
st = out['states'][0]
exp_err = 4*PS - 2*PS - 3500000
chk('T9 half-ps carried error', st['errors_as'][1] == exp_err, st)
# bound = H = (5+2-0... radius = (5-2)/2=1.5ps -> 1500000 + jitter sum 2ps -> 3500000
chk('T9 bound', st['bounds_as'][1] == 3500000, st)

f = base_fabric(links=[{"ends":[[0,0,0],[1,0,1]],"delay_ns":[10,10],"defer_rounds":[0,0]}])

chk('T10 first adopt', out['states'][0]['bounds_as'][1] == 5000000, out['states'][0])
chk('T10 no equal replace', out['states'][1]['bounds_as'][1] == 5000000 and out['adopted'] == 1, out)

# T11 receiver aging across multiple boundaries with heat (bound) and actual drift (err)
f = base_fabric(drift_ppb=[0,1], heat=[[1,1,2,3]], anchors=[[0,0,4]],
                links=[{"ends":[[0,0,0],[1,0,1]],"delay_ns":[15,15],"defer_rounds":[1,1]}])

# actual rates: choose rates[t][1]: row1=+2 → 2*5=10; row2=+7 → 7*10=70 → carried err add 80
trace = tr(sends=[[0,0,0,0]],
           rates_ppb=[[0,0],[2,2],[7,7],[0,0]], bias_ps=[0,0], queries=[3])
out = build(f, prof0, 0, trace)
st = out['states'][0]
expb = 0 + 0 + 30  # src bound 0 + H(0) + aging
exe = 0 + 0 + 2*5 + 7*10
chk('T11 aging bound', st['bounds_as'][1] == expb, st)
chk('T11 aging err', st['errors_as'][1] == exe, st)
